moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The last long weekend of summer arrives as the August Bank Holiday falls on Monday, August 31st across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

angles.name: Last chance for summer fun
angles.copy: Who's making the most of the last bank holiday of summer? Hands up if you're already planning that extra day off! #BankHoliday

angles.name: Travel Alert
angles.copy: Bank Holiday travel warning! Expect busy roads and potential train disruptions across the UK this weekend. Plan ahead!

angles.name: What are your plans?
angles.copy: Beach trip, BBQ, or binge-watching? What's your ideal way to spend the August Bank Holiday weekend?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading and Leeds festivals take over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from August 27-30, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Who's ready for the biggest weekend of the year? Reading & Leeds Festival kicks off on Thursday! What acts are you desperate to see?

angles.name: Headliner Highlight
angles.copy: Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C. – the Reading & Leeds headliners are HUGE! Who's taking the main stage for you?

angles.name: Road to the Festival
angles.copy: Packing the tent or just heading for a day? Good luck to everyone travelling to Reading & Leeds this week!

moments.title: All Points East Returns to London
moments.blurb: All Points East Festival brings a packed lineup to Victoria Park, London, on August 28-29, promising two days of diverse music.

angles.name: London Festival
angles.copy: Victoria Park, get ready! All Points East is back this weekend, bringing big names to London. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: East London Vibes
angles.copy: East London is about to get loud! All Points East kicks off on Friday. Expect big tunes and even bigger vibes.

moments.title: Edinburgh Summer Sessions Live
moments.blurb: The Edinburgh Summer Sessions continue through August 29, bringing live music to the Scottish capital's Princes Street Gardens.

angles.name: Scotland's Summer Sounds
angles.copy: Edinburgh Summer Sessions is in full swing! If you're in Scotland, who are you hoping to catch before it wraps up on Saturday?

angles.name: Garden Gigs
angles.copy: Live music in the heart of Edinburgh? Yes please! Princes Street Gardens is the place to be this week.

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 2 Continues
moments.blurb: The Premier League 2026/27 season heats up with Matchweek 2 fixtures from Friday, August 28, through the Bank Holiday Monday.

angles.name: Weekend Football
angles.copy: Premier League weekend incoming! Matchweek 2 brings us Crystal Palace v Man City on Friday and a Bank Holiday Monday clash with Fulham v Chelsea. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Key Matchups
angles.copy: Liverpool vs Nottingham Forest on Saturday, Spurs vs Newcastle too! What's the standout fixture for you this Premier League weekend?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK #1 Single
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its incredible run, holding the number one spot on the UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Chart Reign
angles.copy: Still at number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is dominating the UK Singles Chart. Can anyone knock them off?

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: 'Rein Me In' made history as the longest-running UK #1 single of all time earlier this summer! Amazing achievement.

moments.title: Phoebe Bridgers Claims UK #1 Album
moments.blurb: Phoebe Bridgers' 'Lost Weekend' hit the top spot on the UK Official Albums Chart last week.

angles.name: Album Chart Topper
angles.copy: New music at the top! Phoebe Bridgers' 'Lost Weekend' is your UK #1 album. Have you streamed it yet?

angles.name: Indie Success
angles.copy: Phoebe Bridgers taking the album chart by storm! A huge win for indie music. What's your favourite track from 'Lost Weekend'?

moments.title: Happy 61st Birthday, Shania Twain
moments.blurb: Country-pop superstar Shania Twain, known for hits like 'Man! I Feel Like a Woman!' and 'That Don't Impress Me Much,' celebrates her 61st birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop
angles.copy: Let's go girls! Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to the one and only Shania Twain! What's your favourite Shania song?

angles.name: Timeless Hits
angles.copy: Still sounds as good today! 'Man! I Feel Like a Woman!' and 'That Don't Impress Me Much' are just two of Shania Twain's timeless tracks. Happy Birthday!

moments.title: Happy 40th Birthday, Florence Welch
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the iconic lead singer of Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Alt-Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the incredible Florence Welch! From 'Dog Days Are Over' to 'Shake It Out,' her music is pure magic. What's your favourite Florence + The Machine track?

angles.name: Vocal Powerhouse
angles.copy: A truly unique voice in music! Celebrating the brilliant Florence Welch's 40th today. Here's to many more years of amazing music!

moments.title: Happy 57th Birthday, Jack Black
moments.blurb: Actor, comedian, and lead singer of Tenacious D, Jack Black, celebrates his 57th birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Rock God Birthday
angles.copy: From School of Rock to Tenacious D, the legendary Jack Black turns 57 today! What's your favourite Jables moment?

angles.name: Comedy & Rock
angles.copy: The man, the myth, the legend! Happy Birthday to Jack Black – bringing joy and rock anthems to the world for 57 years.

moments.title: Al Jardine (The Beach Boys) Turns 84
moments.blurb: Al Jardine, co-founder and rhythm guitarist of The Beach Boys, celebrates his 84th birthday on September 3rd.

angles.name: Beach Boys Legend
angles.copy: Happy 84th Birthday to Al Jardine of The Beach Boys! Thank you for the endless summer vibes. What's your favourite Beach Boys classic?

angles.name: Surf Rock Icon
angles.copy: Still making waves! Celebrating Al Jardine's 84th today. A true legend of surf rock.

moments.title: Steve Jones (Sex Pistols) Turns 71
moments.blurb: Steve Jones, the influential guitarist of punk rock pioneers the Sex Pistols, celebrates his 71st birthday on September 3rd.

angles.name: Punk Rock Pioneer
angles.copy: Anarchy in the UK! Happy 71st Birthday to Steve Jones, legendary guitarist of the Sex Pistols. What's your favourite punk anthem?

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Still sounds as raw and revolutionary as ever! Celebrating Steve Jones' birthday today. A true punk icon.

moments.title: We Out Here Festival 2027 Loyalty Tickets on Sale
moments.blurb: Loyalty tickets for Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival 2027, celebrating soul, hip hop, house, and jazz, go on sale on Thursday, August 27th.

angles.name: Early Bird Alert
angles.copy: Don't miss out! Loyalty tickets for We Out Here Festival 2027 go on sale this Thursday. Get ready for Gilles Peterson's incredible curation!

angles.name: Festival Planning
angles.copy: Thinking ahead to 2027? We Out Here Festival loyalty tickets drop on Thursday. Who are you taking?
